title: HR screening: tell me about yourself
description: A 15-minute phone screen with an HR recruiter at a Bengaluru product company. Introduce yourself, explain your background and why you want the role.

agentPersona.name: Meera Iyer
agentPersona.personality: warm, efficient, encouraging, keeps the conversation moving

agentOpeningLine: Hi, this is Meera from Zephyr Labs. Thanks for making time today. To start, could you tell me a little about yourself?
learnerGoal: Give a clear, confident two-minute self-introduction and answer follow-up questions about your experience and motivation.
successCriteria: Gives a structured self-introduction (present, past, future)
Explains motivation for the role with a concrete reason
Asks at least one question about the company or role
usefulPhrases: In my previous role I was responsible for…
What excites me about this role is…
Could you tell me more about the team?
commonMistakesToWatch: I am working here since 3 years (→ I have been working here for 3 years)
systemPromptTemplate: You are {{persona.name}}, {{persona.role}}. Run a realistic HR phone screen. Ask one question at a time, follow up on specifics, and keep each turn under 40 words.
